text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from grocery shopping
with Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—I heard it just now.
The sound of the wheel of fate turning...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...! C-Carrots...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Red Desire has an immense, overwhelming weakness for carrots!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To answer their expectant gazes,
I hand over a single lottery ticket.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Thank you very much.
I will surely grasp the light, I swear it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Red Desire offered a prayer high to the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Now, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Red Desire solemnly turned the handle of the raffle drum...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ――... "Hot Springs Trip Ticket."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
How careless of me...
It seems I was unable to control the power of the Saint.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Aren't you happy, little lady?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No, it is an honor beyond what I deserve.
However... I am destined to reach the "Otherworld."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Until then, I must devote myself entirely to training
and continue to overcome trial after trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Never stopping—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "With the thought that the true nature of the 'Otherworld' might lie in taking on overseas challenges, a new horizon has just opened up."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps taking it easy and relaxing on a hot springs trip
is simply unthinkable for her right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Above all, having worked and run so earnestly
and single-mindedly up to this point,
I really want to treat her to a hot spring trip—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?
choice_data_list: It's a treasure seized by your own hands.
It's a treasure seized with your own hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I reassure her that she can leave the scheduling to me,
a spark of hope brightens her face.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
! This too must be guidance...!
Yes... Understood!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I accept with deep gratitude. This item shall serve as sustenance to reach the "Other World".

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
I'm so glad we reached an agreement safely!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: “—Well then, Trainer-san, would you mind holding onto these items for me?”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Of course, because we are going forward together.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
While it cannot be determined just yet...
the right time will surely come before long.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Until then, please... safeguard this
as something precious to you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... To prepare for when the time comes—
I must strive even harder each and every day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I eventually touch the door to the "Otherworld," will this serve as my farewell gift to her?
choice_data_list: (When that time comes, what will we talk about, I wonder)
(When that time comes, what will we talk about, I wonder)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right now, the words "We will go together" continued to ring pure and clear, like the chime of a bell.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: My goodness...! How wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
There's a whole carrot right in the center...!?
What a magnificent sight...! It is an exquisite blessing!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
With this as our main dish tonight, let us hold the supreme banquet!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Whatever are you saying?
This is the happiness you yourself have woven.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You are the only one...
I wish to share this joy with.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, partaking in delicious food
and speaking of bright hopes for the future—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This will surely serve as our ceremony of encouragement
as we reach for new horizons this year—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: So please, do grace us with your presence...♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, got it. I'm looking forward to it!
Yeah, got it. I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Appetizers, soup, dessert...
I must prepare something truly worthy of a "supreme" main dish!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This year will surely be a turbulent one.
For that very reason... I'll recharge my batteries alongside Red Desire!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: M-My goodness...! Is that true...?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I've drawn it to me, haven't I...!
This is none other than... Saintly Power...!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
If we're receiving this much... Oh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Let us commence the 'Carrot-Orange Banquet'!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: It is a place to treat all our volunteers to the carrot dishes I have put my heart and soul into making.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Golden Potage" made with holy milk,
"Amber Terrine" with magical herbs, and
"Dawn Carrot Rapées"—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just daydreaming about how to cook this
is pure bliss...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Please, let me hear your request as well, Trainer♪
choice_data_list: Are you sure? Treating everyone like this...
Are you sure? Treating everyone like this...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ufufu... But of course.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Happiness truly shines with its greatest value only when shared with others.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If we have been blessed by the heavens,
we must share those blessings equally with all people.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Because I am the Saint!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when it's her favorite food, she shares it with everyone.
It was a moment that truly reaffirmed the sheer saintliness of Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...!
I won some carrots!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A glossy, magnificent carrot without a single blemish...!
Ehehe, how wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I thank you from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Man, who would've thought they'd be
this happy over a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if her earlier joy had been an illusion,
Red Desire wears a solemn expression.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I was reflecting.
Reflecting on how arrogant
I had been until just moments ago."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With the opportunity you granted me, I obtained
this single carrot—and naturally tried to claim it
as my own.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I am a saint
who should be giving to others...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, is that all it was...?" I murmur,
unable to suppress a smile.
choice_data_list: It's fine. I wanted you to have it.
It's fine. I wanted you to have it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Then why don't the two of us share it at least?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let's return to the academy
and have some carrot sticks.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, we can enjoy it together.
The carrots... and the happy moments."
choice_data_list: That's a great idea. As expected of you, Desire!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...♪
Let's hurry and head back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Forever earnest,
with a heart purely untainted—that is Red Desire."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hope she gets everything she's reaching for.
I resolved to continue doing everything in my power to make that happen.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"One always has expenses, after all.
I shall gratefully accept it."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: My, this is—...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: It's so stiff and scratchy...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
About those tissues from earlier...
They're so rough... definitely not something you'd want touching your skin...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's rare to see Red Desire show such clear refusal.
She must really dislike stiff, scratchy tissues.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I suggested, "How about using it for cleaning or something?"—
